main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-day move per long case (minus coin's normal 5-day drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; fewer than 30 distinct days: not observable

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, upper half minus lower half of entry forecasts

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Calm is read as the regime not being the 'chop' veto and the rise from the recorded rise component (recomputed from closes where missing); a case is the first bet bar in each 5-bar grid cell of its window; t uses day-clustered standard errors with a G/(G-1) correction; upper half = cases with entry forecast above the median, lower half = at or below it; the plan's 'fewer than 30 distinct days' minimum is reported as not observable.
